verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs confirm OAuth support with scoped access (clerk-docs-10/29) and Enterprise SSO covering SAML/OIDC with named IdPs like Azure AD, Okta, and Google Workspace (clerk-docs-8, clerk-docs-28), which matches the 'configuration not code' pattern. However, the evidence pack never explicitly lists the broad set of social providers (Google, GitHub, Facebook, X, etc.) or shows a no-code toggle UI for enabling them, so the core 'broad set of social providers' claim is only inferred rather than directly documented. Missing for 10: an explicit list/count of supported social OAuth providers, and direct evidence of a no-code dashboard toggle for enabling each provider.
